name: Darren Mckeeman
title: Founder
conviction_themes: Blockchain/web3 is the right architecture for privacy-first adult platforms — mainstream payments processors and OAuth will always de-platform adult content
Crypto wallet-based identity eliminates the need for email or personal data, and that is a feature not a bug
Physical anchor spaces are necessary to validate and scale marketplace technology
Women and marginalized communities are habitually underfunded in tech and that must change
Crypto chargebacks problem is solved by eliminating fiat — committed to no-refund crypto-native model
previous_experiences: Co-founded KinkBNB in 2015, grew to 500+ listings in 55 countries by 2019 before COVID disruption.
Relaunched KinkBNB in May 2023 as a decentralized app (dApp) with Ethereum-based social token (KinkToken) and MetaMask login.
Joined Dead Dog Studios as Principal in 2013.
Served as IT Director at Tribe (social network).
Early career as systems admin at Miller/Zell, helped install one of the first CAT-5 networks in Atlanta in 1992.
Published fiction and nonfiction books under Barbary Coast Books; posts chapters to Patreon.
Launched Regulation Crowdfunding community round on WeFunder for KBNB Technologies (~2025).
bio_text: Darren Mckeeman is a San Francisco-based serial founder and systems architect with 30 years in e-commerce who co-founded KinkBNB in 2015 — a blockchain-powered adult playspace marketplace that grew to 500+ locations in 55 countries before relaunching as a web3 dApp in 2023. He is a generalist operator with deep roots in infrastructure, privacy-preserving technology, and community building, and doubles as a published fiction/nonfiction author.
